stepNotes.1: Shell/window + host-config helpers grouped into boot/window-chrome (desktop-boot-outcome, desktop-window-title, desktop-dialog), capture + read policy leaves (desktop-browser-capture-policy, desktop-capture-page-policy contract test, desktop-read-file-policy), host config (desktop-hosts.js 223 LOC), and LAN/file-search/cache helpers (desktop-lan-address, desktop-file-search, external-url, installed-apps-cache).
stepNotes.2: Dominant risk is host-config data integrity and credential hygiene, not capability exposure: clientToken bearer secrets in desktop-hosts.js, normalizeHostUrl strips userinfo/query/hash before storage, isAllowedDesktopHostTargetUrl confines navigation to localOrigin + declared hosts, removeDisabledRemoteAccessSettingsFromRoot is the remote-disable kill switch against DISABLED_REMOTE_SETTINGS_KEYS, and desktop-lan-address must not select a 0.0.0.0/169.254/127.x address.
stepNotes.3: applyDesktopHostsConfigToRoot preserves existing clientToken only when URL+apiUrl unchanged and renderer omits the field (desktop-hosts.js:170-184); explicit-empty token clears the key; targetMatchesHostUrl treats host path '/' as prefix match; isLocalDesktopSenderUrl rejects 0.0.0.0/:: and non-loopback; detectRoutedIPv4Address uses a settled latch for exactly-once resolve + socket.close; normalizeInstalledAppsCache marks future timestamps stale.
stepNotes.4: All helpers are synchronous in-memory gates except detectLanIPv4Address/detectRoutedIPv4Address (one UDP connect, no packets sent, socket closed in callback); readDesktopHostsConfigFromRoot/applyDesktopHostsConfigToRoot iterate the host list twice only on infrequent config writes; isUsableLanIPv4Address is a 4-octet regex check; assertDesktopReadFileAllowed is Array.some over ~17 segments + Set.has; no unbounded allocation or event-loop blocking.
stepNotes.5: Clean small-pure-helper + thin-wiring pattern; desktop-hosts.js concentrates all host/token invariants under one file with consistent sanitize*/normalize*/isAllowed* naming; dependency-injection seams (pathTools, createSocket/networkInterfaces, options.home/tmp) enable cross-platform unit tests without builtin monkey-patching; desktop-boot-outcome kept as a factory to return a fresh non-singleton object per renderer inject; no over-abstraction or layering leak toward desktop/packages/web or packages/ax-code.
stepNotes.6: AUDIT-desktop-electron-shell-empty-catch (Low, deferred 2026-09-11, codex-sol) covers 5 sites in main.js/server-process.js/startup-diagnostics.js outside the helper modules; the two in-scope empty catches (desktop-hosts.js:16 URL-parse sentinel, desktop-lan-address.js:47 socket.close guard) are locally correct; hasUrlControlCharacter is a defensive header-injection guard; no TODO/FIXME; the hasApiUrl/hasClientToken hasOwnProperty checks are load-bearing for token-clearing semantics.
stepNotes.7: Every shell helper has a substantive .test.mjs: desktop-hosts.test.mjs (357 LOC) covers token round-trip preservation, explicit-empty clearing, and no-token-carryover-on-endpoint-change for both URL and apiUrl; desktop-capture-page-policy.test.mjs asserts safeForRemote:false via contract JSON AND source-greps main.js for safeForRemote:true; installed-apps-cache.test.mjs pins the future-timestamp staleness invariant. Gaps: malformed localOrigin rejection, the socket.address() throw branch, and pinning DISABLED_REMOTE_SETTINGS_KEYS against future key additions.
stepNotes.8: Single registered finding (empty-catch, Low, deferred, codex-sol verifier) is policy-compliant with per-site rationale; no Critical items in findings/ so no reverify.md required for gate passage; no new Critical/High/Medium issues surfaced: host token storage round-trip-safe, navigation allowlisting origin+path correct, URL sanitization strips credentials pre-persistence, disabled-remote-access purge key-complete, read containment sound, LAN selector rejects bind-unusable addresses.
stepNotes.9: Authoritative desktop vitest commands per helper .test.mjs plus desktop:typecheck/desktop:lint/desktop:test; not executed here for budget; main.js (2767 LOC) not read in full and its three empty-catch sites are tracked by the deferred finding for verifier-lane follow-up; desktop:build is a wave-gate concern rather than per-unit.
